title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
abstract: arXiv:2611.26414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). translated_title: ZeroVLN：无需对VLM大脑进行监督微调的学习导航方法
translated_abstract: 代表性的视觉-语言导航（VLN）方法通常将视觉-语言模型（VLM）大脑与一个可学习的动作头相结合，并在导航领域数据上对VLM大脑进行微调，以预测几何目标。然而，这种适配可能会大幅改变基础VLM的权重，从而损害其通用视觉能力。我们提出了ZeroVLN，这是一个快慢结合（slow-fast）的导航框架，能够在对VLM大脑进行零导航领域监督微调（SFT）的情况下实现有效导航。我们不是教大脑去预测几何目标，而是为其配备一个语义工具调用接口，使其能够以自然语言向动作专家传达移动决策。我们首先适配动作专家以执行这些移动请求，然后通过闭环强化学习（RL）联合改进大脑的移动决策和动作专家的连续执行。在相同的导航回合数据上训练，ZeroVLN大幅超越了代表性方法（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: ZeroVLN提出一种快慢结合的导航框架，无需对VLM大脑进行任何导航领域监督微调，而是通过语义工具调用接口让大脑以自然语言传达移动决策，并借助闭环强化学习联合优化大脑决策与动作专家执行，在保持VLM通用视觉能力的同时实现有效导航。
en_tdlr: ZeroVLN is a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective VLN without any navigation-domain supervised fine-tuning of the VLM brain, using a semantic tool-calling interface for natural-language movement decisions and closed-loop reinforcement learning to jointly optimize the brain's decisions and the action expert's execution.
